scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
A human?!
This land is full
of your kind. What
brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
人类？！
这片土地上到处都是你们这种人。
你们来这里干什么？

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Living in Midgard and away from
my home town is painful enough, let alone facing a whiny human. Leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
离开家乡，生活在米德加尔特已经够痛苦了，还要面对你们这些爱抱怨的人类。别来烦我！

scripts.text: Ask him about Dwarves.
scripts.translation: 询问关于矮人的事

scripts.text: Ask him what he is doing.
scripts.translation: 询问他在做什么

scripts.text: Request weapon creation.
scripts.translation: 请求打造武器

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
What's to know about Dwarves?
We're the toughest race. After all, we can live anywhere, no matter
how harsh the environment may be.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
矮人有什么好了解的？
我们是最强壮的种族。毕竟，无论环境多么恶劣，我们都能在任何地方生存。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I doubt your feeble mind can comprehend the how unendurable
it must be for you to live in my homeland, but you can try.
Try to imagine.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我怀疑你那脆弱的头脑无法理解，生活在我的故土对你们来说是多么难以忍受，但你可以试着想象一下。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Most of the knowledge and skills that you humans are so proud of were probably handed down from Dwarves.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
你们人类引以为傲的大部分知识和技能，很可能都是矮人传授给你们的。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
This is especially true in the
case of smithing. Even the tools and weapons of the gods were made by my ancestors. You know that?
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
尤其是在锻造方面。就连众神的工具和武器，也是由我的祖先打造的。你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
We have the greatest knowlege and skills, but have accepted our fate to live in the cold, barren lands of the Giants.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我们拥有最渊博的知识和技艺，却不得不接受命运，生活在巨人那片寒冷贫瘠的土地上。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Did you just ask what I am doing here? Mwahahaha! Waiting for any humans stupid enough to come
here so I can kick their ass!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
你刚才问我在这里做什么吗？哇哈哈！我在等那些愚蠢到敢来这里的人类，好痛扁他们一顿！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Oh don't worry. I'd only humiliate myself by fighting with a weakling like you. Humans are so fragile, but they stubbornly cling to their arrogance and fight amongst
each other.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
哦，别担心。和你这种弱者打架只会让我自降身份。人类虽然脆弱，却固执地抱着傲慢不放，还互相争斗。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
As a race, your people are just hopeless. I wouldn't even share the same continent with a human! But alas, I have no choice.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
作为一个种族，你们简直无可救药。我甚至不愿和人类生活在同一片大陆上！但唉，我别无选择。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
The path to my hometown
disappeared after the war 1,000 years ago. Somehow, I can no longer find the way through the Yggdrasil Tree that will take me back...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
一千年前的那场战争之后，通往我家乡的道路消失了。不知为何，我再也无法找到通过世界树回到那里的路...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I'm stuck here in Midgard.
At least I was fortunate enough to find this cave. We Dwarves are most cozy living underground, after all.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我困在米德加尔特了。
至少我有幸找到了这个洞穴。毕竟，矮人在地下生活最舒适了。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmm...
I'll need some things to make a weapon for you. What exactly were you interested in having?
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
嗯...
我需要一些材料才能为你打造武器。你具体想要什么？

scripts.text: Brisingamen
scripts.translation: 女神项链

scripts.text: Megingjard
scripts.translation: 雷神腰带

scripts.text: Sleipnir
scripts.translation: 史雷普尼尔之靴

scripts.text: Mjolnir
scripts.translation: 雷神之锤

[Dwarf Grunburti]
I will need...
^0000FF4 Freya's Jewel
4 Silver Ornament
3 Snow Crystal
3 Ripple
3 Drifting Air
2 Sapphire
3 Pearl
10 Opal
5 Cursed Ruby
20 Gold^000000
1 Necklace^000000...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我需要...
^0000FF4 菲力亚宝石
4 银饰品
3 雪的结晶
3 涟漪
3 空气雕像
2 蓝宝石
3 珍珠
10 蛋白石
5 诅咒红宝石
20 金币^000000
1 项链^000000...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
However, the time for me to create this Brisingamen has not yet come. You'll have to wait until the seals are released. Mwahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
不过，打造女神项链的时机尚未到来。你得等到封印解除才行。哇哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I will need...
^0000FF1 Gleipnir
20 Gold
10 Sapphire
10 Oridecon
1 Belt^000000
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我需要...
^0000FF1 魔法铁链
20 金币
10 蓝宝石
10 神之金属
1 腰带^000000

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
However, the seals on Megingjard have not yet been released. Until then, you'll have to wait! Bwahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
不过，雷神腰带的封印尚未解除。在那之前，你得等着！哇哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I will need...
^0000FF3 Wheel of the Unknown
5 Feather of Angel Wing
3 Sprit of Fish
4 Amblem of the Sun God
3 Breath of Spirit
20 Gold
10 Elunium
1 Slotted Boots^000000
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我需要...
^0000FF3 未知的锯齿轮子
5 天使翅膀羽毛
3 鱼之精灵
4 太阳神的徽章
3 灵魂的呼吸声音
20 金币
10 铝
1 带孔靴子^000000

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But even so, I can't create Sleipnir until the seals have been broken. Otherwise, you're out of luck, human. Hahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
但是即便如此，在封印解除之前，我也无法打造史雷普尼尔之靴。否则，你就只能自认倒霉了，人类。哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I will need...
^0000FF2 Thor's Gauntlets
4 Iron Maiden
5 Wrath of Valkyrie
5 Omen of Tempest
5 Billow
20 Oridecon
5 Elunium
40 Gold
1 Stunner^000000
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我需要...
^0000FF2 托尔的铁手套
4 拷问器具
5 瓦尔基里的愤怒
5 暴风雨的征兆
5 气流
20 神之金属
5 铝
40 金币
1 电击棒^000000

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But I can't even create a replica of Mjolnir if the seals are still in place. Until they're released, you'll just have to wait. Bwahaha!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
但是，如果封印还在，我连雷神之锤的复制品都无法打造。在封印解除之前，你就只能等着。哇哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
We Dwarves have too much pride to demonstrate our skills in front of a lowly human!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我们矮人有着极高的自尊心，绝不会在低贱的人类面前展示我们的技艺！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Stop bothering me and get out of here! Go play with some monsters, you simple minded fool!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
别烦我了，快滚出去！去跟那些魔物玩吧，你这个头脑简单的蠢货！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I'll only present
my magnificent skills
to a human of incredibly
high standing!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我只会在地位极其崇高的人类面前，展示我精湛的技艺！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Although I hate
most humans, I have
no choice but to respect the ones chosen by destiny. Go and bring your ^0000FFguildmaster^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
虽然我讨厌大多数人类，但我别无选择，只能尊重那些被命运选中的人。去把你的^0000FF公会会长^000000带来！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Although it is very humiliating to present my valuable skills to a human being...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
虽然向人类展示我宝贵的技艺是一件非常屈辱的事情...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
All the seals have been released, and he who holds the Emperium is chosen by destiny. I have no choice but to respect you.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
所有的封印都已解除，持有华丽金属的人便是被命运选中的人。我别无选择，只能尊重你。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
First of all, I shall confirm whether or not you have brought all the necessary materials to forge a godly item! I hate it when humans come here without any purpose!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
首先，我要确认你是否带来了打造神器所需的所有材料！我最讨厌那些毫无目的就来这里的人类了！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmm...
I guess you
want to have
^0000FFBrisingamen^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
嗯...
看来你是想打造
^0000FF女神项链^000000！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmm...
I guess you
want to have
^0000FFMegingjard^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
嗯...
看来你是想打造
^0000FF雷神腰带^000000！

scripts.text:

Hmm...
I guess you
want to have
^0000FFSleipnir^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
嗯...
看来你是想打造
^0000FF史雷普尼尔之靴^000000！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmm...
I guess you
want to have
^0000FFMjolnir^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
嗯...
看来你是想打造
^0000FF雷神之锤^000000！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
...
......

[Dwarf Grunburti]
...
......
.........

[Dwarf Grunburti]
How dare you come here unprepared?! Did you forget what you needed to bring? Listen carefully this time!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
你竟敢毫无准备地来到这里？！你忘了需要带什么了吗？这次给我听仔细了！

Brisingamen,
the seals will

快一点...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmpf.
I can't get any work done in here. Come with me to the ^0000FFunderground laboratory^000000 as my guest, human.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
哼。
在这里没法干活。跟我来^0000FF地下实验室^000000吧，人类，作为我的客人。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Now hurry up! ^0000FFOnly one of each godly item^000000 will be given to the humans ^FF0000right after all the seals are released^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
快一点！^0000FF每种神器只有一件^000000，会在^FF0000所有封印解除后^000000立即交给人类！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Muhahahahahaha!
Out of my sight,
you dirty, filthy
human...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
穆哈哈哈哈哈！
滚出我的视线，
你这肮脏、
污秽的人类...

scripts.text:
[Entrance Notice]
Only the most
worthy of humans
will possess the
power of the gods.
scripts.translation:
[入口告示]
只有最优秀的人类
才能拥有
神的力量。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
One of the godly
items has been created,
and the seals have been
restored. You'll have to
wait until they're all
released again...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
一件神器已经制造完成，
封印已经恢复。
你得等到它们
再次被解除...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Bwahahahahahahaa!
Even though you're
just a human, I feel
pity for you~
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
布哇哈哈哈哈哈！
虽然你只是个
人类，但我还是
有点同情你~

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
How in the...
Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
怎么...
给我滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
How did one of you
stupid humans get in
here?! Only those who
hold the Emperium can
even think of entering
this place...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
你们这些愚蠢的人类
是怎么进来的？！
只有持有华丽金属的人
才能进入这里...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
It's incredibly
humiliating to do work for a human. But since destiny has chosen you as the bearer of an Emperium, I have no choice but to oblige your requests.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
为人类干活真是
奇耻大辱。但既然命运
选中了你作为华丽金属的持有者，
我别无选择，只能满足你的要求。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
We only have
^FF000010 minutes^000000 to recreate one godly treasure. After that, the seals will restore themselves and I won't be able to create anything until they're released again...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
我们只有
^FF000010分钟^000000的时间来重现一件神器。之后，封印会自行恢复，在封印再次解除之前，我无法制造任何东西...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
^FF0000Don't be too slow^000000,
otherwise ^FF0000I will give
the chance to another
human^000000 right away!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
^FF0000别太慢了^000000，
否则我会^FF0000立刻把机会
给另一个人类^000000！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Now...!
Choose the item
you wish for me
to create!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
现在...
选择你希望我
制造的物品！

scripts.text: Brisingamen
scripts.translation: 女神项链

scripts.text: Megingjard
scripts.translation: 雷神腰带

scripts.text: Sleipnir
scripts.translation: 史雷普尼尔之靴

scripts.text: Mjolnir
scripts.translation: 雷神之锤

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
B-Brisingamen?!
I've never expected
such insolence...!
This necklace will never have any meaning in my eyes unless it's worn by the goddess Freya.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格伦布尔蒂]
神...女神项链？！
我从未想过
会有如此无礼的要求...
除非是女神菲力亚佩戴，
否则这条项链在我眼中毫无意义。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But who am I to judge your worthiness? These treasures

scripts.text:
